notes: Fixed two serious fabricated-data bugs found by a targeted audit of the hardware backplate visualization and switch validation logic. (1) getSystemPortMappings() -- the function feeding every rear-panel port diagram and the Cabling Audit Table -- fabricated every port name, IP address, WWPN, link status, and cabling-partner switch/port identity from a hash of the system's serial number, for every platform. Rewired it to build the port list from Active IQ's real per-port networkPorts telemetry (already harvested, already correctly used elsewhere in the app); ports/fields with no real data source (FC/SAS role, cabling partner identity, IP address -- none of these exist in the networkPorts schema) are now honestly shown as unavailable instead of invented, and link-state color coding now has a real gray 'unknown' state instead of forcing every port to green or red. (2) getSystemSwitches() fabricated 1-3 entire fake switches -- including specific invented CVE numbers (e.g. 'CVE-2023-20092') -- presented as real findings for actual customer equipment whenever Active IQ hadn't discovered/monitored a switch for that system. Now honestly returns nothing, letting the existing 'not discovered/monitored' UI states in the callers handle it. Also fixed a version-comparison bug (versionLt()) that silently dropped the build number from Cisco's parenthetical firmware format (9.3(12)), which could misjudge two different Cisco releases as equal, and corrected README's switch firmware baseline table which had drifted from the live data/firmware_baselines.json (Cisco NX-OS baseline moved to 10.4.2, Broadcom EFOS to 3.12.0.1, plus AFX-specific switch models were undocumented).
